I booked 6 Hotel rooms in advance 30 days before And make all the payment at the time of booking.My stay at The Royal Hotel was unfortunately marred by a very uncomfortable interaction with the front desk staff upon check-out.
Despite having a confirmed booking and my charges clearly outlined on my reservation confirmation, the staff attempted to charge me an unexpected and previously undisclosed serviced fee they increase the rooms charges at the time of check- in.When I politely questioned this discrepancy and presented my booking voucher showing the total amount already paid, the staff insisted on the extra payment, delaying my departure significantly.
It felt as though the staff was attempting to gain extra money without a legitimate reason documented in my initial agreement. A professional hotel should honor the rates confirmed at the time of booking and ensure transparent pricing from the start. This lack of transparency and the high-pressure situation created during check-in significantly tarnished my opinion of this establishment.
I would caution future guests to print out their reservation details and confirm all charges in advance to avoid a similar scenario. I will not be returning to this hotel due to this poor experience with their staff and billing practices.
